description: Starts, stops, restarts, enables, disables, or inspects status of background system services (systemd, launchctl, Windows Services).

parameters.name: service
parameters.description: Name of the system service (e.g. docker, postgresql, bluetooth, nginx)

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Action to perform: start, stop, restart, enable, disable, status

optionalParameters.name: userScope
optionalParameters.description: Whether to run in user scope (e.g. systemctl --user)
